capability: Full custodian adapter feeds and multi-custodian support

risk_if_deferred: Manual import errors misstate fund balances and grantable capacity; reconciliation labour is transferred to the servicer's ops staff (not eliminated); custodian file formats still needed later

capability: Multi-pool NAV unitization engine (beyond a single pooled valuation)
condition: Single investment pool or per-fund segregated accounts valued directly from custodian; NAV publication not delegated (CNV-FIN-005 is already sponsor-activation)
risk_if_deferred: Wrong unit allocation is a financial-correctness defect affecting every fund; cannot be deferred if pooled investments with unit accounting are offered

capability: Percentage grants and multi-investment funding
condition: Release 1 offers fixed-amount grants only

capability: Multi-sponsor white-label configuration and tenant isolation profiles beyond one deployment profile

capability: Bulk migration and onboarding tooling
condition: First sponsor is greenfield or migrates few hundred funds by supervised scripted load with dual reconciliation

capability: Card contributions
condition: Contributions by ACH/wire/check via sponsor processor only

capability: Donor-covered fees in acknowledgments
condition: Fees not passed to donors

capability: UBIT accrual default

capability: Call recording and SMS/voice channels

capability: Agent-executable commands above authority A2

capability: Board-delegated deterministic grant approval; discretionary holds; delegated SoD release

capability: Continuous control monitoring platform (expected-evidence scheduler etc.)

capability: Governed public APIs for all 36 domains and embedded widgets

risk_if_deferred: Partner/advisor integrations unavailable; reduces commercial reach
